# Machine Learning Estimators {#sec-ml}

| Argument | Role | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `model_deltay` | Regresses ΔY on baseline treatment for stayers | `LinearRegression()` |
| `model_stayer` | Models P(stayer) | `LogisticRegression()` |

---

## ML.01 — Default sklearn {#sec-ml01}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat
from sklearn.ensemble import (RandomForestRegressor, RandomForestClassifier,
                               BaggingRegressor, BaggingClassifier)
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPRegressor, MLPClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor, DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, LogisticRegression

SEED = 42
gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                       placebo=2, aoss_vs_waoss=True)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
m.summary()
```

## ML.03 — Neural Network {#sec-ml03}

::: {.callout-warning}
N=48 units only — large standard errors expected. Neural networks need N>500 to train reliably.
:::

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat
from sklearn.ensemble import (RandomForestRegressor, RandomForestClassifier,
                               BaggingRegressor, BaggingClassifier)
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPRegressor, MLPClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor, DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, LogisticRegression

SEED = 42
gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)

m = DIDMultiplegtStat(
    estimator=["aoss","waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
    placebo=2, aoss_vs_waoss=True,
    model_deltay=MLPRegressor(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,32), max_iter=300,
                               random_state=SEED, early_stopping=True),
    model_stayer=MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64,32), max_iter=300,
                                random_state=SEED, early_stopping=True),
)
m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
m.summary()
```

## ML.08 — Comparison Table {#sec-ml08}

```python
import warnings
warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import pandas as pd
from did_multiplegt_stat import DIDMultiplegtStat
from sklearn.ensemble import (RandomForestRegressor, RandomForestClassifier,
                               BaggingRegressor, BaggingClassifier)
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPRegressor, MLPClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeRegressor, DecisionTreeClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, LogisticRegression

SEED = 42
gazoline = pd.read_stata(
    "https://github.com/chaisemartinPackages/ApplicationData/raw/main/data_gazoline.dta"
)
import time

strategies = {
    "Default (sklearn)": {},
    "asinstata":         {"asinstata": True},
    "Random Forest":     {
        "model_deltay": RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=50, max_depth=5, random_state=SEED),
        "model_stayer": RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=50, max_depth=5, random_state=SEED)},
    "Bagging (trees)":   {
        "model_deltay": BaggingRegressor(estimator=DecisionTreeRegressor(max_depth=4),
                                          n_estimators=50, random_state=SEED),
        "model_stayer": BaggingClassifier(estimator=DecisionTreeClassifier(max_depth=4),
                                           n_estimators=50, random_state=SEED)},
}
for name, kwargs in strategies.items():
    t0 = time.time()
    m = DIDMultiplegtStat(estimator=["waoss"], order=1, controls=["lngpinc"],
                           placebo=1, **kwargs)
    m.fit(gazoline, Y="lngca", ID="id", Time="year", D="tau")
    elapsed = time.time() - t0
    tbl = m.results_["results"]["table"]
    coef = float(tbl.loc["WAS"]["Estimate"])
    se   = float(tbl.loc["WAS"]["SE"])
    print(f"{name:25s}  WAS={coef:+.7f}  SE={se:.7f}  ({elapsed:.1f}s)")
```

```
                        WAS        SE  Time(s)
Strategy                                      
Default (sklearn) -0.003754  0.001018     5.45
asinstata         -0.003756  0.001019     4.21
Random Forest     -0.003152  0.000945    19.29
Bagging (trees)   -0.003103  0.000930    26.66
```
